name: Darkness Energy
text:
If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. At the end of every turn, put 1 damage counter on the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to, unless it's [D] or has Dark in its name.

Darkness Energy provides [D] Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Metal Energy
text: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't [M]. Metal Energy provides [M] Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Beginning Door
text: Search your deck for Arceus, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Burning Tail
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy attached to Charizard.

powers.name: Fire Formation
powers.text: Each of Charizard's attacks does 10 more damage for each [R] Pokémon on your Bench to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Call for Friends
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Expert Belt
text: The Pokemon this card is attached to gets +20 HP and that Pokemon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokemon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). When the Pokemon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Ripple Swell
attacks.text: If you have 6 Arceus in play and each of them is a different type, search your deck for up to 6 basic Energy cards. Attach each of those Energy cards to a different Pokémon you have in play. Shuffle your deck afterward

attacks.name: Sky Spear
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Remove all Energy cards attached to Arceus and put them in the Lost Zone

attacks.name: Metal Barrier
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Arceus by Pokémon LV.X during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Ground
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Lightning Turn
attacks.text: Switch Arceus with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fastwave
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bright FLame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Energy attached to Arceus.

attacks.name: Leaf Refresh
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Prize Count
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards left than your opponent, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Psychic Bolt
attacks.text: Discard a [L] Energy and a [P] Energy attached to Arceus.

powers.name: Multitype
powers.text: Arceus LV.X's type is the same type as its previous Level.

attacks.name: Meteor Blast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack's base damage is 50 instead of 100.

powers.name: Multitype
powers.text: Arceus LV.X's type is the same type as its previous Level.

powers.name: Multitype
powers.text: Arceus LV.X's type is the same type as its previous Level.

powers.name: Omniscient
powers.text: Arceus can use the attacks of all Arceus you have in play as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Ground Frost
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium Card in play, this attack does nothing.

powers.name: Snow Gift
powers.text: Once during your turn, when you play Froslass from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Shadow Skip
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) You may switch Gengar with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

powers.name: Curse
powers.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. This power can't be used if Gengar is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Lucky Egg
text: When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Darkness Grace
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) If you do, put 1 damage counter on Spiritomb. Shuffle your deck afterward.

powers.name: Keystone Seal
powers.text: As long as Spiritomb is your Active Pokémon, each player can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand.

name: Ultimate Zone
text: During each player's turn, the player may move an Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon to his or her Active Arceus as often as he or she likes.
